critical_correction: The candidate proof is organized around primality of every element, not around atomic irreducible->prime plus inverse-limit witness reconstruction.

rows.SRS_requirement: Each active local shadow monoid is an internal direct sum of independent atomic coefficient monoids.
rows.candidate_proof_evidence: Associated-graded algebraic independence and polynomial presentation make the germ quotient a polynomial ring; this gives local four-factor refinement.
rows.reason: The proof establishes local polynomial-ring/refinement structure, but does not exhibit the SRS direct-sum coefficient-monoid decomposition required by I.

rows.SRS_requirement: Each local coefficient monoid is atomic and every irreducible is prime.
rows.candidate_proof_evidence: The repository proves irreducible omnific integers are prime, but the final refinement route proves every element primal (pre-Schreier) directly.
rows.reason: Irreducible->prime is not the operative hypothesis in the final route. ConwayRefinement.lean derives refinement from every element being primal. SRS P is therefore not the proof's actual local engine.

rows.SRS_requirement: Every residual obligation created by a local step has strictly lower ordinal rank.
rows.candidate_proof_evidence: Factoring at a quotient Archimedean class leaves a cofactor whose nonzero support-class order type is strictly smaller; LimitTailPrimality recurses on this rank.
rows.reason: This is an exact structural match to SRS well-founded descent.

rows.SRS_requirement: At a limit obligation, nonempty lower witness sets have a nonempty coherent inverse limit of witnesses.
rows.candidate_proof_evidence: Cauchy completeness of the common-tail quotient is used to obtain exact refinement at a suitable closed Archimedean class.
rows.reason: The proof does not construct an inverse limit of refinement-witness sets. Completeness is used inside a quotient theorem that directly produces a local refinement. SRS L is stronger and differently typed.

rows.SRS_requirement: A local shadow refinement plus lower-rank residual witnesses assemble soundly into a witness for the current obligation.
rows.candidate_proof_evidence: Closed-class refinement is transported to a factorisation of a retained ambient block; the complementary cofactor is proved primal by induction; these are spliced into a primal refinement.
rows.reason: The proof has an explicit local lift/transport/splice step. It matches R1 if obligations are encoded as primality/divisibility obligations rather than four-factor endpoint obligations.

rows.SRS_requirement: A coherent inverse-limit family of lower-stage witnesses reconstructs to an exact witness at a limit obligation.
rows.candidate_proof_evidence: No such witness-family reconstruction appears in the audited route.
rows.reason: Limit stages are handled by quotient completeness producing a local refinement, not by reconstruction from an inverse limit of witnesses.

rows.SRS_requirement: Global route closure follows after solving all ranked obligations.
rows.candidate_proof_evidence: The proof establishes every signed bounded Hahn integer-part element is primal, packages this as a DecompositionMonoid, then uses the generic equivalence to four-factor refinement and transports across signed normal form.
rows.status: PASS, BUT VIA DIFFERENT ABSTRACT ENDGAME
